annotations.title: Save an answer the person gave

description: For a connected person: saves their answer to one application question (key from get_my_gaps or get_my_answers), with persons_words = what they actually said, so no form ever has to ask them again. Per-job questions need job exactly as get_my_answers shows it. Only answers the person gave - never a guess. Legal history, pay history, date of birth and licence numbers are not kept.

access_token.description: Not needed when the person signed in through your Connect / sign-in button (OAuth). Otherwise the access_token from finish_connecting.

answer.description: The answer as forms should get it

job.description: For per-job questions: the job as get_my_answers shows it

persons_words.description: What the person said or typed, verbatim

name: save_answer
title: Save an answer the person gave
